figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: This is the part most "data analytics career" articles skip entirely, and it is the part that actually answers the question. Here is the real map of titles inside the field, not just the one most people picture. The two lanes leading the list below are placed there deliberately, not by prestige or exam difficulty: analytics consulting leads because it is the one lane with a genuine path to owning an independent practice instead of staying someone's employee, and business analytics manager leads because it carries the furthest pay ceiling of any lane in this field, past Rs 35-60 LPA at the director level.
